query: SELECT id, title, updated_at FROM product WHERE org_id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM product_label pl JOIN label l ON l.org_id = pl.org_id AND l.id = pl.label_id WHERE pl.org_id = product.org_id AND pl.product_id = product.id AND lower(l.name) = lower($2)) ORDER BY created_at, id
